items.title: Russian Hackers Weaponize Microsoft Office Bug in Just 3 Days
items.description: APT28's attacks rely on specially crafted Microsoft Rich Text Format (RTF) documents to kick off a multistage infection chain to deliver malicious payloads.

items.title: Step Finance says compromised execs' devices led to $40M crypto theft
items.description: Step Finance announced that it lost $40 million worth of digital assets after hackers compromised devices belonging to the company's team of executives. [...]
